# BAGER SITE LINK — UI/brand agent

Mission: make all five participant role screens consistent, readable and usable on a phone.

Brand rule: use only the user's explicitly approved original logo. No redesign, generated replacement or substitute logo may be presented as approved. The exact binary logo must exist at static/bager-site-link-logo.jpg and return HTTP 200 in the deployed application.

Check: header top-left placement, legibility, responsive layout, contrast, tap targets, empty/loading/error states, Bulgarian labels and consistent role identity. Capture actual device screenshots and record approval status.

Never mark the logo as complete merely because HTML references an image path. A text fallback is a resilience measure, not completion.
